svg.title: Icarus Verilog Waveform: CORDIC Rotation Mode (Opcode 00, A = 10, Angle = +28.125 deg)
svg.text: Icarus Verilog Waveform: CORDIC Rotation Mode (Opcode 00, A = 10, Angle = +28.125 deg)
Captured from src/project.v + test/replay.v (10 ns clock period, posedge at 5 ns, 15 ns, ..., 135 ns)
C3 (35ns): START=1 loads x=311 (round(512/K)), y=0, z=160 (10*16) and raises BUSY=1.
C11 (115ns): iter=7 completes; BUSY drops to 0. RSEL=0 outputs cos = 451>>2 = 112 (112/128 = 0.8750 vs 0.8819).
